page.overview:
Who is Zonnos Anjiliac Priare?

Zonnos Anjiliac Priare was a Hutt of the Anjiliac kajidic. He was framed for the murder of his father, Popara Anjiliac Diresto, by his brother, Mika Anjiliac Chiera, the real murderer.
